title: ajuga suffrutescens
intro: Ajuga suffrutescens, commonly known as Chinese bugle, is a type of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and lowering blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Ajuga suffrutescens include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Ajuga suffrutescens have been shown to exhibit neuroprotective and hepatoprotective effects, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of various diseases.
